legacy_system.name: Gilded Rose Inventory Kata (Unclassified / Non-FAA-Mapped System)
legacy_system.description: A 172-line, single-assembly C# console application (the publicly published 'Gilded Rose Refactoring Kata') that seeds a fixed in-memory item list and applies a nightly Quality/SellIn rules engine to it. It has no HTTP surface, no database, and no observed aviation, NAS, or FAA business content, so it cannot be confidently bound to any strategy-of-record legacy system family; it is carried here as its own unclassified system pending stakeholder confirmation of whether this application_id genuinely maps to an FAA-owned production system.

business_domains.name: Unclassified / Non-Aviation Inventory Exercise
business_domains.description: A standalone nightly inventory quality and sell-in revaluation exercise with no observed mapping to any FAA business domain (Air Traffic, Flight Safety, Certification, Workforce, Finance, Logistics, Admin/Travel) in the reference taxonomy.

capabilities.name: asset-and-inventory-management
capabilities.description: Applies a per-item-type rules engine that adjusts each stocked item's remaining sell-in days and quality level once per night (normal goods, Aged Brie, Sulfuras, Backstage passes, and an unimplemented Conjured-item rule), enforcing quality bounds in-process. Invoked by a single interactive operator running the console executable; there is no other caller, scheduler, or upstream/downstream integration.
